sources.title: WCAG 2.2
sources.consequence: accessibility is testable but requires both automated and human evaluation; use perceivable/operable/understandable/robust as foundation

sources.title: ARIA Authoring Practices Guide
sources.consequence: widgets require semantics, keyboard support, states, and accessible names; do not infer UX quality from ARIA presence

sources.title: Web Vitals
sources.consequence: track LCP <= 2.5s, INP <= 200ms, CLS <= 0.1 at 75th percentile; metrics are experience targets, not visual design scores

sources.title: Playwright accessibility testing
sources.consequence: axe automation catches a subset; manual assessment and inclusive user testing remain required

sources.title: Color Management
sources.consequence: color management affects physical accuracy, display consistency, and artistic look; record it in lookdev evidence

sources.title: Unreal Engine 5.8 Documentation
sources.consequence: content, world building, rendering, Niagara, gameplay, UI, audio, testing, optimization, and release are distinct production disciplines

sources.title: Python ast
sources.consequence: syntax trees improve structural repository intelligence over text-only matching

sources.title: Language Server Protocol
sources.consequence: definitions, references, symbols, and diagnostics should route through LSP/compiler services when risk justifies it

limitations: Source retrieval is evidence for curriculum design, not proof of model mastery.
Tool-specific behavior must be revalidated after version changes.
